title: Mega-Sena 3063 Accumulates, Prize Reaches 52 Million Reais
seoTitle: Mega-Sena 3063 Jackpot Rises to R$52 Million
subtitle: Sunday's drawing had no main prize winner, increasing the value for the next edition
excerpt: Mega-Sena contest 3063, held this Sunday (27), had no main prize winner, causing the jackpot to rise to R$52 million and generating significant interest.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Mega-Sena contest 3063, held on Sunday morning (27) in São Paulo, had no winner who matched all six numbers. As a result, the prize, which would have been R$45 million, accumulated to R$52 million, drawing the interest of thousands of players who follow the drawing.

How Mega-Sena Accumulation Works

When no ticket wins the main prize tier, the total prize amount is transferred to the next contest. In the case of edition 3063, the sum increased from R$45 million to R$52 million, making the next drawing even more attractive for those wishing to try their luck.

Prizes for Matching Five or Four Numbers

Even without a main prize winner, the contest recorded 29 winning bets for the quina (five matches), each receiving R$73,111.35. Additionally, 2,642 bets matched the quadra (four numbers) and were awarded R$1,322.81 each.

How to Place a Bet

The minimum bet costs R$6 and can be placed until 8 PM at any lottery house or through the Loterias Caixa website and app. Bets placed online can be paid via PIX, credit card, or internet banking, provided the bettor is 18 years or older.

Probability of Winning

For a simple game with six numbers, the probability of hitting the maximum prize is 1 in 50,063,860, according to Caixa. If the player chooses to mark 20 numbers – the maximum limit – the cost of the bet rises to R$232,560.00, but the chance of victory increases to 1 in 1,292.

Live Broadcast of the Drawings

Since April, g1 has been broadcasting all Loterias Caixa drawings live, starting a few minutes before the official time. The broadcast can be followed on the g1 website and the broadcaster's YouTube channel.

With information from G1.
